scholarships.scholarship_name: The University of Auckland Top Achiever Scholarship
scholarships.source_doc: University of Auckland Top Achiever Scholarship - Specific Terms of the Scholarship (regulations PDF under the Scholarships and Prizes Statute 2025, in force 20 May 2026), plus the official 'University of Auckland Top Achiever Scholarships' detail page with the payment schedule, application-form content, benefits and retaining conditions.
scholarships.deadline_note: No separate institutional deadline is published; a single University-wide closing date applies to all applicants in the round. The webpage notes that scholarship applications usually open around six weeks before the closing date, and dates for the next round are not yet published.
scholarships.application_cycle: Annual entry-level (school-leaver) round for first-year study commencing 2027 - opened 20 May 2026 and closed 12 August 2026 at midday; dates for the next round are not yet published.
scholarships.status_note: The scholarship page states "Application status: Not currently open for applications". The most recent published round opened 20 May 2026 and closed 12 August 2026 at midday; outcomes for that round are notified by email in early October.
scholarships.tuition_coverage_note: No published statement that tuition fees are covered. The regulations state the purpose as "For costs directly related to study at the University", and the detail page states the instalments may be spent on study-related costs "such as tuition fees, books for study, additional hall of residence costs not already covered by the scholarship, travel to and from university etc or to support your living costs while you are studying". The award does not pay tuition fees directly.
benefits: Up to $27,000 in total comprising one year of catered accommodation in a Waipapa Taumata Rau, University of Auckland Hall of Residence plus $5,000

$5,000 paid in two instalments in the first two semesters of study - $2,500 credited to the recipient's bank account in each of the first two semesters, usually in the fourth week after enrolment closes
One year of catered accommodation in a University Hall of Residence, with the accommodation component paid directly to the relevant Hall of Residence, including the deposit and administration fee
Free membership to Hiwa, Recreation Centre
Each Hall offers catering, your own room, and resident support including a range of activities and events, academic mentoring programmes and pastoral care
eligibility: New Zealand Citizen or Permanent Resident (Australian citizens or permanent residents must also be a New Zealand Citizen or hold a New Zealand Permanent Resident visa)
Currently enrolled in Year 13 at a New Zealand secondary school or kura
Intending to enrol full-time in the first year of an undergraduate degree or conjoint degree at the University in the year directly after completing secondary school or kura, or the following year

For Maori applicants or Pacific applicants only: a Certificate in Health Sciences followed by an undergraduate degree or conjoint degree at the University in the year directly after completing secondary school or kura, or the following year
Must have applied for accommodation in a University Hall of Residence before the closing date for the scholarship
requirements: Read the regulations carefully before applying
Apply for accommodation in a University Hall of Residence before the scholarship closing date
Achieve admission to the University with an NCEA rank score of at least 270, a CIE rank score of at least 330, an IB score of at least 36, or an equivalent for other qualifications
Take up a place in a University Hall of Residence (exceptions considered only under exceptional circumstances, case by case)
Achieve a GPA of at least 6.0 (equivalent to a B+ average) in the first semester of study to remain in accommodation and receive the second instalment
Complete at least four consecutive semesters of study at the University
Enrol full-time - at least 100 points over two semesters in one year (Summer Start study does not count towards the first 100 points of undergraduate study)
Enter your bank account details into the Personal Bank Account section in Student Services Online (must be a New Zealand bank account)
Accept the offer by the date stated in the awarding notification, otherwise the scholarship offer will be forfeited
Must not hold the scholarship concurrently with any other accommodation scholarship
documents: Endorsement from the applicant's school or kura - a required selection criterion under the Specific Terms
Year 12 Level 2 or higher NCEA, CIE or IB results, including the predicted score for Year 13, or an equivalent qualification, as assessed by the University
A separate application for accommodation in a University Hall of Residence, lodged before the scholarship closing date
selection_criteria: Outstanding academic ability based on results achieved at Year 12 in Level 2 or higher in the National Certificate of Educational Achievement (NCEA), or CIE, or IB, or an equivalent qualification
Endorsement from the applicant's school or kura
May also inform selection: the applicant's demonstrated leadership potential
May also inform selection: the applicant's achievements in academic, sports or arts competitions
May also inform selection: the applicant's participation in visual and performing arts
May also inform selection: recognition of the applicant within their community
May also inform selection: financial need as determined by the applicant's eligibility for a StudyLink Student Allowance
May also inform selection: the Equity Index number of the most recent secondary school or kura attended

May also inform selection: the applicant is the first in their family to attend a tertiary institution and no family member has completed a tertiary qualification prior to the applicant's first year of study
May also inform selection: the applicant or their parents/primary guardian(s) have been granted refuge in New Zealand
May also inform selection: the applicant has a disability
May also inform selection: the applicant has care responsibilities for whanau
May also inform selection: the applicant attended secondary school or kura in a rural or regional area
coverage: One year of catered accommodation in a University Hall of Residence, paid directly to the relevant Hall of Residence
Up to $5,000 for costs directly related to study at the University - "To avoid doubt, costs directly related to study include living expenses to enable study"
Additional hall of residence costs not already covered by the scholarship, books for study, travel to and from university, or living costs while studying (permitted uses of the instalments)
scholarships.field_of_study: All faculties (Faculty/LSRI: All); first year of full-time study for an undergraduate or conjoint degree programme
scholarships.subject_or_agency_requirement: None - open to all faculties; applicable to the first year of full-time undergraduate study. Maori and Pacific applicants may instead enrol in a Certificate in Health Sciences followed by an undergraduate degree.
scholarships.citizenship_residency: New Zealand Citizen or Permanent Resident
scholarships.international_eligibility: No - eligibility is limited to New Zealand Citizens or Permanent Residents, so international students do not qualify.
application_method: Applications must be made using the online application portal on the Scholarships Office webpage
Remember to save your application as you go, and once all sections are 100% completed you can submit your application
scholarships.application_route: Apply online through the University of Auckland's scholarship application portal (linked from the Find a scholarship page) when the round opens, and separately apply for a University Hall of Residence place before the closing date.
scholarships.description: Awarded to exceptional students who have excellent academic achievement and demonstrated leadership potential. Per the regulations, the objective is to recognise and reward exceptional academic performance combined with outstanding sporting, artistic, cultural and/or leadership activities, and the provision of university accommodation is designed to provide the best student experience and promote excellent academic outcomes.
not_confirmed: funding_min_amount: not published. The University states the value as "Up to $27,000 in total" because the accommodation component's dollar value varies by Hall of Residence, so no fixed minimum total value is published.
travel_coverage: no separate travel allowance is published; the $5,000 instalments may be spent on travel to and from university among other study-related costs.
english_requirement: no English language requirement is published for this New Zealand school-leaver scholarship.
research_requirement: not published (no research requirement applies to this undergraduate scholarship).

Next-round application dates: not published. The page states "Application status: Not currently open for applications"; the University notes rounds usually open around six weeks before the closing date.

The complete checklist of documents to upload in the online application form is not published; the regulations incorporate "any requirements stated on the application form or stipulated in writing by the Director".
scholarships.verification_notes: All facts re-verified live on 2026-10-10 against the official find-a-scholarship page, the official Specific Terms PDF (in force 20 May 2026) and the official Top Achiever detail/payment-schedule page. Migration corrections: (1) number on offer corrected from the existing "held with at most 4" to "Up to 250" as stated in the Specific Terms; (2) amount recorded as up to NZD 27,000 in total (max) rather than a flat 27,000 - the accommodation component's value varies by Hall, so funding_min_amount is null; (3) funding schedule clarified: $5,000 paid as two $2,500 instalments in the first two semesters (usually the fourth week after enrolment closes each semester), with accommodation paid directly to the Hall in both semesters and the deposit and administration fee covered; (4) status changed to closed - the last published round opened 20 May 2026 and closed 12 August 2026 at midday and the page states "Application status: Not currently open for applications"; (5) living_cost_coverage confirmed true via the purpose clause "costs directly related to study include living expenses to enable study"; (6) tuition_coverage false - no published statement that tuition fees are covered; (7) tenure confirmed one year, eligibility restricted to New Zealand Citizens or Permanent Resident.

scholarships.verification_notes: All facts re-verified live on 2026-10-10 against the official find-a-scholarship page, the official Specific Terms PDF (in force 20 May 2026) and the official Waka Moana/Vaka Moana detail page (payment schedule, laptop terms, benefits, retaining conditions). Migration corrections: (1) existing scholarship_desc said only that the recipient is "eligible for a Hall of Residence"; the official wording is that the value comprises one year of catered accommodation in a University Hall of Residence plus a laptop, supplied by the University and kept by the recipient - the laptop brand is not published; (2) value recorded as up to NZD 24,000 in total (max), not flat, with funding_min_amount null; (3) number on offer is officially "Varies"; (4) status changed to closed - the last published round opened 20 May 2026 and closed 12 August 2026 at midday and the page states "Application status: Not currently open for applications"; (5) retaining wording confirmed as "achieving a passing grade in all courses in their first semester" plus full-time enrolment in the second semester - the existing "passing session record" phrase matches in substance but the official wording is recorded here; (6) admission requirement confirmed at NCEA/CIE rank score 160 or IB 25; (7) eligibility confirmed as Indigenous Pacific descent from the published island list plus New Zealand citizenship or permanent residency; (8) repayment rule confirmed - if four consecutive semesters are not completed, the recipient repays the full value of accommodation and returns the laptop.
